points.description: Answer names the main function (main()) as the function involved (accept 'main', 'main()', 'main function', 'मुख्य फंक्शन').
Answer states that program execution begins/starts from the main function (accept equivalent wording such as 'main function पासून', 'starts from main', 'main is the entry point').

rubric.notes: Full marks (5/5) for an answer that names main() and says execution starts from it. 3/5 for naming main() only without stating that execution starts from it. No marks for naming any other function or saying execution starts elsewhere.
